summary: Fixes the self-updater: the pre-update script (which update.blade.php downloads from pre-update.linkstack.org and overwrites locally) used to @include a separate links-table migration file that older installs don't have; the links-table upgrade (add links.type/type_params columns, set type from button_id for versions < 4.8.1) is now inlined into pre-update.blade.php and the separate file deleted. Column creation now only runs for versions < 4.8.1.

statements.why: Same database upgrade logic, just moved into one file; updater page remains admin-only; no new exposure. (Runs remote-downloaded code by design, pre-existing.)
Now contains the links-table upgrade; card doesn't say so.
Its content was moved into pre-update.blade.php.

misses.what: Updating LinkStack from older versions through the built-in updater should work again: the step that upgrades the links table (adds link type columns and sets each link's type) is now part of the downloaded pre-update script instead of a separate file older installs lack.
The update step changes the links database table (adds columns, rewrites link types) for installs older than 4.8.1; take a backup before updating.
